steps.title: Discovery & Requirement Analysis
steps.description: We begin by understanding your business objectives, target audience, competitors, and website requirements. Our team identifies essential features, user expectations, and opportunities to create a website that strengthens your online presence and supports your business goals

steps.title: Website Planning & Technical Strategy
steps.description: We develop a clear website development roadmap covering project scope, site structure, functionality, technology selection, and delivery milestones. Our team plans a scalable technical architecture and SEO-friendly URL structure to establish a strong foundation for website performance, usability, and future growth.

steps.title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping
steps.description: Our designers create visually engaging, intuitive, and conversion-focused website interfaces that reflect your brand identity. Through wireframes, interactive prototypes, and responsive layouts, we ensure visitors can navigate your website easily across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

steps.title: Custom Website Development
steps.description: We transform approved designs into fast, functional, and scalable websites using modern web technologies and reliable coding practices. Whether you need a business website, custom web application, eCommerce platform, or API integration, we build tailored solutions with a focus on performance, security, and maintainability.

steps.title: Website Testing & Quality Assurance
steps.description: Before launch, we thoroughly test your website to ensure its features work correctly and deliver a consistent experience across supported browsers and devices. We evaluate functionality, mobile responsiveness, loading speed, accessibility, and essential security measures while resolving issues that could affect usability or reliability.

steps.title: Website Launch & Deployment
steps.description: Once your website passes quality checks and receives final approval, we prepare it for production deployment. Our team assists with hosting configuration, domain and SSL setup, analytics integration, and essential technical SEO checks to help your website launch smoothly and reach your target audience.

steps.title: Website Maintenance & Continuous Improvement
steps.description: Our partnership continues after your website goes live. We provide ongoing website maintenance, technical support, security updates, bug fixes, and feature enhancements to keep your website reliable and up to date. As your business grows, we help optimize performance, improve user experience, and scale your digital platform to meet evolving business needs.

items.question: What web development services does WrathCode Technology offer?
items.answer: WrathCode Technology provides custom website development, responsive web design, web application development, eCommerce website development, frontend and backend development, API integration, and website maintenance. We build tailored digital solutions that help businesses establish a strong online presence and achieve their business goals.

items.question: How much does it cost to develop a website?
items.answer: The cost of website development depends on your project requirements, design complexity, features, integrations, and technology stack. A simple business website generally costs less than a custom web application or feature-rich eCommerce platform. At WrathCode, we evaluate your requirements and provide a suitable development estimate based on your goals and budget.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a website?
items.answer: Website development timelines depend on the size and complexity of the project. A basic business website may take a few weeks, while a complex website or custom web application may require several months. We define the project scope, milestones, and estimated delivery timeline before development begins.

items.question: Does WrathCode provide custom website development?
items.answer: Yes. We specialize in custom website development tailored to your business objectives, brand identity, and target audience. Whether you need a corporate website, business portal, booking platform, or custom web application, we build solutions around your specific requirements rather than relying solely on generic templates.

items.question: Will my website be mobile-friendly and SEO-friendly?
items.answer: Yes. We develop responsive websites designed to work across desktops, tablets, and smartphones. We also consider essential technical SEO practices, including clean URL structures, metadata, semantic HTML, mobile usability, and page performance, to help search engines understand your website and users access your content easily.

items.question: Which technologies does WrathCode use for website development?
items.answer: Our technology choices depend on your project requirements. We work with modern technologies and frameworks such as React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Python, PHP, and Laravel, along with platforms such as WordPress and Shopify where appropriate. We recommend a technology stack based on your functionality, scalability, performance, and maintenance needs.

items.question: Can WrathCode develop eCommerce websites and custom web applications?
items.answer: Yes. We develop eCommerce websites, online marketplaces, customer portals, business dashboards, booking systems, and custom web applications. Our solutions can include payment gateway integration, inventory management, authentication, third-party APIs, and other features required to support your business operations.

items.question: Does WrathCode provide website maintenance and support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing website maintenance and technical support to help keep your website secure, reliable, and up to date. Depending on your requirements and support agreement, our services can include bug fixes, software updates, performance optimization, security improvements, and new feature development.

items.question: Can WrathCode redesign my existing website?
items.answer: Yes. We can redesign your existing website to improve its visual appearance, user experience, mobile responsiveness, loading performance, and maintainability. We assess your current website, identify areas for improvement, and recommend a redesign strategy aligned with your brand identity and business objectives.

items.question: How do I get started with WrathCode for my website development project?
items.answer: Getting started is simple. Contact our team and share your business goals, website requirements, preferred features, budget, and timeline. We will discuss your project, recommend a suitable development approach, and outline the next steps to help turn your idea into a functional, high-quality website.
